gaps.gap: The ice is dominated by a single massive circular gradient pattern rather than four distinct, soft light pools separated by shadows.
gaps.change: Remove the global circular light/texture and place four distinct spotlights aimed at the ice quadrants, lowering the ambient light to create shadows between them.

gaps.gap: The black ink outlines on the figures do not scale with distance, causing the players further away to turn into messy black blobs.
gaps.change: Multiply the line width in the outline post-process shader by the inverse of the scene depth so lines get thinner further from the camera.

gaps.gap: The boards have a yellow top and bottom line, missing the specified ochre kick plate, dark glass rail, and team-coloured emissive trim.
gaps.change: Update the board material to feature an ochre band at the base, a dark band at the top, and change the glowing trim to deep blue and warm orange.

works: Chunky toy proportions and clear deep blue/warm orange jersey separation.
The puck is successfully highlighted by a saturated glowing disc.
The far net is immediately findable thanks to the red frame and HUD marker.
The deep-blue night dome sits well above the dark silhouette line.
answer.lead_sentence: We have the toy proportions and the basic palette working well, but the flat global lighting and uniform outlines are killing the painted cel night-time vibe.
